name: social-pipeline-workspace
description: Social media content pipeline — Telegram bot operator + React dashboard reviewer, sharing one engine (research, drafting, SEO/GEO, humanizer, media gen, Postiz publishing)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd engine && npm install && cd ../dashboard/social-pipeline-dashboard && npm install
